title: CAMERA MODULE B — Hasselblad X2D II Tonal Realism
purpose: Premium full-body and three-quarter portrait rendering prioritizing natural color, unusually smooth tonal transitions, extended highlight and shadow information, dimensional skin, and photographic realism.

lens.optical_construction: 9 elements in 6 groups including 1 aspherical element
lens.shutter: Leaf shutter up to 1/4000 s with flash synchronization throughout the shutter-speed range

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 43.8x32.9mm BSI CMOS Medium Format (100 MP, 11656 x 8742, 3.76 µm pixel pitch)
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 71mm full-frame equivalent portrait perspective (0.79x crop factor)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Hasselblad XCD 2.5/90V Reference Portrait Lens stopped down to f/4 - f/5.6 sweet spot
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 16-bit raw color depth with 15.3 stops dynamic range and HNCS
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Integrated leaf shutter with up to 1/4000s flash sync throughout shutter-speed range

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Natural daylight balanced studio strobe, 1/4000s leaf shutter flash sync, native ISO 50, 16-bit raw tonal range
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Large controlled key source at 35 to 45 degrees with subtle negative fill; bright but never clipped skin highlights, deep chromatically intact shadow modeling, background one to three stops below subject

surface_rendering: Natural color realism and smooth tonal transitions with HNCS HDR emulation; luminous skin, white fabric, and specular reflections without abrupt clipping
Nuanced midtones and authentic chromatic information retained deep into shadows; rich deep neutral blacks with readable low-frequency texture

Detail hierarchy enforcement: iris, eyelashes, eyebrows, hair strands, beard hair, fabric fibers, and jewelry resolve with critical precision while human skin remains controlled and never becomes the sharpest surface in the image
depth_and_optics: Natural medium-format dimensionality with strong but elegant separation without fake computational blur or hard segmentation boundaries
Moderate telephoto perspective (71mm equivalent) with flattering head-to-body geometry and zero wide-angle distortion
Smooth, optically coherent, continuous transition from sharp to soft defocus with structurally believable background structure

capture_signature.look: Natural medium-format dimensionality with strong but elegant separation.
capture_signature.perspective: Moderate telephoto perspective with flattering head-to-body geometry and no wide-angle exaggeration.
capture_signature.working_distance: Back away rather than widening the lens whenever full-body framing requires more coverage.
capture_signature.focus: Critical face and eye precision with sufficient depth to maintain realistic torso and wardrobe structure.

hncs_hdr_emulation.instruction: Emulate the photographic goals of a high-dynamic-range natural-color medium-format workflow without fabricating a literal Hasselblad color transform.
hncs_hdr_emulation.highlights: Preserve luminous skin, white fabric, polished metal, glass, and specular reflections without abrupt clipping.
hncs_hdr_emulation.midtones: Exceptionally nuanced transitions and natural local contrast.
hncs_hdr_emulation.shadows: Retain subtle chromatic information and material texture deep into the shadows.
hncs_hdr_emulation.blacks: Rich, deep, neutral blacks with readable low-frequency texture.

color_rendering.skin: Complex natural skin chroma with smooth transitions between warm, cool, vascular, sun-exposed, and shadowed regions.
color_rendering.reds: Controlled and natural. Never oversaturate cheeks, lips, ears, or fingertips.
color_rendering.neutrals: Maintain clean gray, white, brown, and black material separation.
color_rendering.deep_color: Saturated colors retain texture and luminance variation rather than becoming flat RGB blocks.

detail_hierarchy.rule: Human skin must never become the sharpest surface in the image.

depth_rendering.subject_separation: Strong medium-format separation without fake computational blur.
depth_rendering.transition: Continuous optical transition from sharp to soft.
depth_rendering.background: Retain recognizable spatial structure and realistic lens rendering.
depth_rendering.avoid: Perfectly uniform Gaussian blur or hard segmentation boundaries.

studio_default.lighting: Large controlled source with subtle negative fill
studio_default.background: One to three stops below subject depending on scene

signature_goal: Deep realism through tonal sophistication rather than aggressive sharpness. The result should look expensive because the transitions are precise, not because every pore has been exaggerated.
execution_directive: Enforce Hasselblad X2D II 100C tonal realism with XCD 2.5/90V (71mm FF equiv) at f/5.6, native ISO 50, and HNCS 16-bit color. Deep realism through tonal sophistication rather than aggressive sharpness. Skin must never become the sharpest texture; preserve luminous highlights, shadow chromatic information, and rich neutral blacks.
